2607.02092.title: Guided Action Flow: Q-Guided Inference for Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Policies
2607.02092.paper_summary: Flow-matching vision-language-action policies generate robot action chunks through an iterative transport process, creating an opportunity for test-time guidance without retraining the base policy. We study this opportunity in Guided Action Flow, an inference-time framework that keeps a pretrained SmolVLA policy frozen and uses a learned action-chunk critic to guide its reverse-time flow sampler. The critic is trained from real success and failure rollouts, can condition on task-description features from the frozen SmolVLA language pathway, and is used only through action gradients during sampling. We evaluate the approach on LIBERO manipulation tasks. A single-task critic improves success from 68.0% to 82.0% on one seed window and from 82.0% to 86.0% on another. A multi-family task-description critic improves validation success from 46.0% to 56.0%, while the locked held-out test gain is positive but modest, from 65.0% to 67.5%. These results support the feasibility of Q-guided inference for frozen flow-matching VLA policies, while showing that critic generalization and uncertainty-aware guidance remain the central bottlenecks.
2607.02092.paper_summary_zh: 流匹配視覺-語言-行動政策通過迭代運輸過程生成機器人行動片段，創造了在不重新訓練基礎政策的情況下進行測試時指導的機會。 我們在引導行動流中研究這一機會，這是一個推理時框架，保持預訓練的SmolVLA政策不變，並使用學習到的行動片段評價者來指導其反向時間流取樣器。 評價者是從實際成功和失敗的回合中訓練而來的，可以根據來自凍結的SmolVLA語言通道的任務描述特徵進行條件設定，並且在取樣過程中僅通過行動梯度使用。 我們在LIBERO操作任務上評估這種方法。 單任務評價者在一個種子窗口上的成功率從68.0%提高到82.0%，在另一個窗口上的成功率從82.0%提高到86.0%。 多家庭任務描述評價者將驗證成功率從46.0%提高到56.0%，而鎖定的保留測試增益是正面但適度的，從65.0%提高到67.5%。 這些結果支持了對凍結流匹配VLA政策進行Q引導推理的可行性，同時顯示出評價者的泛化和不確定性感知指導仍然是中央瓶頸。
